pages.text: $(thing)Requirement$(): Path of Hunger 3, costs 3 levels.$(br)$(thing)Type$(): active.$(br2)All mobs within a radius of 3 blocks (in config $(thing)screamRadius$()), both peaceful and hostile, will join your side: they will not attack you and will attack those who have harmed you.

The effect lasts for 60 seconds (in config $(thing)screamDurationSeconds$()). Bosses are unaffected. Peaceful mobs without the ability to attack will only stop being a threat. Consumes hunger and has a cooldown.
